title: Mountains and Waters
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett shares a Native American story called "Jumping Mouse" about a mouse who discovers new insights and perspectives through exploration and understanding, illustrating the idea that our perceptions can be expanded beyond our individual limits. The story teaches us to approach life with humility and openness, recognizing that our experiences are interconnected and that we have the power to transform ourselves and others. By embracing this perspective, we can heal and connect with one another, ultimately realizing our shared nature as "eagles" in spirit.
